messages:
sasha: Heads up — seeing a flaky failure in the structured-toolcall CI after the q8b quant bringup. Sometimes the function resolves to `tools.add`, sometimes to `math.add`. Can't repro deterministically locally. @jamal any initial thoughts?

jamal: I can repro semi-locally. Only happens when the runner batches 2+ requests together. Single-request runs are stable.

anya: CI job: evals/structured-toolcall/flaky-route #1287 — failing ~40% of reruns. Attaching the failing snippet from the runner log.

anya: ```
[2026-03-19T21:45:12Z] request_id=abc123 routed_fn=tools.add args={"a":1,"b":2}
[2026-03-19T21:45:12Z] request_id=abc124 routed_fn=math.add args={"a":1,"b":2}
[2026-03-19T21:45:12Z] batch_id=7 kv_cache_hit=true route_decision="reuse_prefix"
```

ci-bot: Build 1287 failed: test structured-toolcall (flake). Rerun queued (#1290). :repeat:

liz: Could be routing state leaking across batch slots when KV cache is reused. I hit a similar symptom in a different test last week after the KV alignment tweak.

jamal: Ran a quick git-bisect — suspecting commit `0a1b2c3` (runtime-routing: kvcache alignment edge case). Repro steps I used in the issue: run the eval runner with `--batch-size 2 --seed 42` repeatedly.

sasha: Nice — can you put the bisect result and minimal repro in an issue? If this is cache-state leaking we should pin the structured-toolcall CI to non-quantized model until fixed.

jamal: Filed #452 with logs, repro, and bisect info. Temporary guard in CI: pin MODEL_VARIANT=q4h-std for the flaky job.

liz: For the longer fix: I think the router needs to clear per-slot transient metadata when it reuses KV caches across sequences. I'll prototype a patch Monday.

sasha: Thanks team. Adding a short note to the eval-runner README about batching caveats and the CI guard. Will follow up once jamal's PR lands. :eyes:

ci-bot: Rerun #1290 started (agent:ci-runner-3).
